label: TSMM canonical primitive catalog
description: Canonical primitive catalog for the TSMM core meta-model formalization maintained on the main branch without requiring a tagged release.

primitiveDefinitions.description: Any person, organization, software agent, or system component that can participate in a trust-relevant flow.

fieldDefinitions.name: identifier
fieldDefinitions.description: Stable identifier for the actor primitive in the canonical meta-model.

notes: Operational TSMM instances refine Actor through roles and authorities.

primitiveDefinitions.description: A bounded right, mandate, permission, or recognized competence attached to a role.

fieldDefinitions.name: identifier
fieldDefinitions.description: Stable identifier for the authority primitive.

fieldDefinitions.name: authority_source
fieldDefinitions.description: Origin of the authority, such as law, governance framework, contract, or delegation chain.

fieldDefinitions.name: revocation_mechanism
fieldDefinitions.description: How the authority can be suspended, revoked, or expire.

primitiveDefinitions.description: A structured artifact that carries a trust-relevant claim set and can be checked for validity over time.

fieldDefinitions.name: identifier
fieldDefinitions.description: Stable identifier for the credential primitive.

fieldDefinitions.name: validation_method
fieldDefinitions.description: How the credential is checked for authenticity and integrity.

fieldDefinitions.name: revocation_mechanism
fieldDefinitions.description: How the credential status can be invalidated or rechecked.

notes: TSMM core uses the more general Artifact abstraction for operational instances.

primitiveDefinitions.description: Ruleset governing acceptance, denial, downgrade, routing, or escalation.

fieldDefinitions.name: identifier
fieldDefinitions.description: Stable identifier for the policy primitive.

primitiveDefinitions.description: A modeled reliance relationship that connects participants, artifacts, or decisions under stated conditions.

fieldDefinitions.name: identifier
fieldDefinitions.description: Stable identifier for the trust relationship primitive.

notes: In the current core schema, trust relationships are represented operationally through trust decisions, authority references, and effect references.

primitiveDefinitions.description: A transfer or grant of bounded authority from one participant or role to another.

fieldDefinitions.name: identifier
fieldDefinitions.description: Stable identifier for the delegation primitive.

fieldDefinitions.name: authority_source
fieldDefinitions.description: Source chain or upstream authority that legitimizes the delegation.

fieldDefinitions.name: revocation_mechanism
fieldDefinitions.description: How the delegation can be withdrawn, expire, or be superseded.

notes: Delegation remains modeled through authority plus conditions in the current core instance schema.

primitiveDefinitions.description: A checking operation that evaluates whether an expected trust condition holds.

fieldDefinitions.name: identifier
fieldDefinitions.description: Stable identifier for the verification primitive.

fieldDefinitions.name: validation_method
fieldDefinitions.description: Method used to evaluate the target condition.

notes: This schema formalizes the primitive catalog for TSMM itself.
Operational trust-system examples continue to validate against schemas/tsmm-core.schema.json and extension schemas.
